notes.title: NEW RELEASE
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to unveil our latest creation, a captivating journey that will transport you to a world of mystery and adventure like never before! 🌟 Introducing "13:ORIGIN - Chapter I" - our brand new game now available on Steam!

Puzzles & Mysteries: Engage your intellect in a series of mind-boggling puzzles that will challenge even the sharpest minds. 

We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to our dedicated community whose passion and support have allowed us to bring "13:ORIGIN - Chapter I" to life. We couldn't have achieved this without you, and we promise that this is only the beginning of an extraordinary adventure.

13:ORIGIN - Chapter I is now available on Steam!

🔗 Grab your copy today: 13:ORIGIN Chapter - I

Join us in shaping the legacy of "13:ORIGIN - Chapter I," and together, let's unveil the secrets that lie within!

See you in the game! 🌌

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
-We have enhanced tutorial part of the game. You won't be confused anymore.
-Subtitles and hints are now more remarkable.
-Fixed an issue where cryptex was scaling when crouched
-Sensitivity and Volume options can be properly saved.
-Additional SFX was added for certain objects. 
-Fixed typo errors in journal.
-Minor bugs were fixed.
-One more achievement was added.


On the other hand, we are about to kick our main game's project on Kickstarter. We kindly ask your help to achieve our goal. Definitely, that campaign is going to help us a lot. 

13:ORIGIN KICKSTARTER CAMPAIGN


Cheer!
